artist.headline: Rhythm in My Hands:
artist.subtitle: Meet Priscilla Torres, the creative soul behind Son de Nudos.
artist.intro: For years, my life revolved around music. The transverse flute, percussion, piano... each instrument taught me something invaluable about precision, rhythm, and discipline.
artist.story: When I discovered macramé, I found a new language to express everything music had given me. Each knot I tie is like a note in a score: precise, intentional, part of a greater composition.
artist.philosophy: What was once sound is now texture. What was melody is now movement. My hands continue creating art, only now the stage is different. Welcome to my new stage.
artist.quote: Each piece carries a bit of my musical soul. The rhythm never leaves me.
